page.overview:
Who is Kotch?

Kotch is a recurring character in the Final Fantasy VII series. He is a minor antagonist in Final Fantasy VII, Final Fantasy VII Remake, and Final Fantasy VII Rebirth.

Kotch is a lieutenant of the Corneo Family, serving with his partner Scotch under Don Corneo. He is energetic, dramatic, faithful to his boss, and has a knack for emceeing at events relating to the don.

Kotch stood by Corneo alongside Scotch at the audition during the "To Corneo Hall" in Final Fantasy VII. He lined up Tifa Lockhart, Aerith Gainsborough, and a crossdressing Cloud Strife before the don, then watched from the back. After Corneo made his pick and let his men have the "leftovers", Kotch saluted and eagerly escorted Aerith to the dungeon. He chased her around the room until Cloud arrived, but an apologetic Aerith pushed him down the stairs as they escaped, leaving him dazed and muttering about wanting a "nice girl".

During the Shinra Electric Power Company's raid on Corneo's mansion, Kotch was left tied to a torture table in the dungeon in "Aeris's Secret". He yelled for help until Cloud's party appeared and freed him. Kotch explained that Shinra had attacked, accused him of leaking information, called him useless, and took Corneo away before he rushed off.
